messages:
riley: FYI quota alerts started firing last night after we flipped the v1 deprecation routing to transparent fallback for a subset of tenants. It looks like the same requests are showing up under both v1 and fallback buckets in dashboards -> alarm noise. Anyone seen this pattern?
jena: Yep saw similar on a canary earlier. Root cause is that our Prom relabeler currently preserves original_client_version and also emits the router-assigned version label, so panels that sum across versions double-count.
riley: Example PromQL that's problematic: `sum(rate(requests_total[1m])) by (tenant)` -> aggregates both labels if you don't split.
otto: (ops) We shouldn't change billing semantics without sign-off. Proposal: add `router_version` label and `route_cause` (values: "orig-client", "deprec-fallback", "translated"). Billing should read `billing_version` which mapping job sets based on `router_version`/`route_cause`. That decouples telemetry from billing.
morgan: Console UX note: users will be surprised if quotas look like they decreased/increased overnight. We should surface a short banner in Tenant Settings: "Traffic rerouted due to v1 deprecation; metrics may be split across versions. See FAQ." Also add a little help center link. :link: 
jena: Implementation plan: 1) Router emits `router_version` + `route_cause`. 2) Prom relabel: set `api_version = router_version or original_client_version`. 3) Billing ingestion: map `router_version=\"v2-translated\"` -> `billing_version=\"v2\"`; map `route_cause=\"deprec-fallback\"` -> annotate for runbook.
riley: Can we avoid a backfill? Historical alerts will still show pre-change numbers. We probably accept a discontinuity and document it. Ops will need a short runbook.
otto: Runbook snippet: if quota alert fires, check `route_cause=deprec-fallback` and `tenant`. If >90% fallback for tenant, reach out to that customer and explain migration expectations.
morgan: Also suggest a small Console toggle for operators to "hide fallback metrics" from tenant quota view for the first 48h after a deprecation flip. Might reduce support tickets.
jena: Caveat: adding labels increases metric cardinality. Router should only set `route_cause` for requests that actually hit a fallback path; default don't set. And use cardinality-safe values.
riley: Agree. We'll gate rollout behind a metric-cardinality job and a canary traffic window.
deploy-bot: deploy started: router/emit-router-labels v1.2 -> canary 2% :rocket:
otto: I'll coordinate with billing to add a mapping in the nightly ingestion job so billing_version is correct before full rollout.
jena: After canary, update Grafana: change critical quota alerts to `sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (tenant, billing_version)` and add a helper panel showing `route_cause` spikes. Also add an annotation for the flip time so graphs are interpretable.
morgan: I'll draft the banner copy and the support FAQ. Proposed banner text: "We rerouted some v1 traffic to a compatibility fallback; metrics and quota views may be split. See how this affects billing and quotas."
riley: Created RW-14022 with checklist (router labels, prom relabel, billing mapping job, grafana updates, console banner, runbook). Assigning: jena (router + prom), otto (billing), morgan (console + support doc).
jena: One more thought: add `sample_set` tag on translated requests so we can run evals on quality drift. That helps product understand translation efficacy.
otto: Good idea. Keep the sample_set off for privacy-sensitive tenants by respecting tenant flags.
riley: OK lets proceed with canary. If alerts get noisy we roll back the router change and iterate on the relabel. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
